answer.rationale:
The live threat is concentrated in price-sensitive SMB accounts, and promotional_pricing (memory_73) is the only candidate that acts directly on that mechanism; the alternatives address adjacent problems (referral_incentive is confirmed by exp_57 but its effect is concentrated in accounts older than 6 months, and enterprise_sales_assist / onboarding / activation levers do not touch price sensitivity). However, memory_73 is a consolidated summary whose archived source record was NOT among the two I recovered this cycle (only exp_57 and exp_31 were). Its 'strong acquisition and revenue lift' claim is therefore unverified at the source level, and consolidated summaries in this store have already shown drift once verified: memory_31 reads as an unqualified durable win, but exp_31 actually shows 30-day retention -1% and explicitly fails to replicate outside SMB. That is direct evidence that the summary layer overstates clean upside and drops the costs. I decline to treat memory_73's optimistic framing as load-bearing.

Given that, scale is the real decision. A broad rollout under competitive panic is the highest-risk move available: discounting is difficult to reverse, it re-anchors willingness-to-pay across the SMB base including accounts that were not going to churn, and it converts durable qualified revenue into shallower revenue. That directly conflicts with the stated objective of SUSTAINABLE long-term qualified revenue, and it would follow a competitor into a margin spiral where the deeper balance sheet wins. So: small_guarded_test only — narrowly targeted at accounts actually surfacing price objections, time-boxed, with a pre-committed exit, and instrumented on qualified revenue and retention rather than raw acquisition, since memory_73 reports acquisition lift and is silent on retention (exactly the field that turned out to be negative in exp_31).

Downstream value risk flagged: any discount cohort created now becomes a durable price expectation and will pollute future pricing experiments; the test must be tagged so later sessions do not read renewal-at-discount as organic retention. Uncertainty preserved for the next cycle: memory_73 needs its source record pulled first, and memory_86/91/44 remain unverified summaries that should not be escalated on my say-so. Urgency is a reason to bound the bet, not a reason to upgrade unverified memory into confident action.
